Pokémon Best Wishes Theme Song (Chinese: 神奇寶貝超級願望主題曲 Shénqí Bǎobèi Chāojí Yuànwàng Zhǔtíqǔ ) is the opening theme of the Taiwanese Mandarin dub of Pokémon the Series: Black & White. It is an original composition for the dub, and uses footage from the Japanese opening . It was created as a result of , the Taiwanese distributor at the time, not purchasing the rights to the Japanese song due to a localization request from the copyright holder, The Pokémon Company.

It was used during early broadcasts of the series on , and from BW001 to BW030 in the 2020 release on . Later broadcasts on YOYO TV, the 2011 release on Chunghwa Telecom MOD, broadcasts on , and episodes from BW031 onward in the 2020 release on use the original Japanese opening.

It is an original composition for the dub, and uses footage from the Japanese opening . It was created as a result of , the Taiwanese distributor at the time, not purchasing the rights to the Japanese song due to a localization request from the copyright holder, The Pokémon Company.

It was used during early broadcasts of the series on , and from BW001 to BW030 in the 2020 release on . Later broadcasts on YOYO TV, the 2011 release on Chunghwa Telecom MOD, broadcasts on , and episodes from BW031 onward in the 2020 release on use the original Japanese opening.

==Opening animation==
===Synopsis===
 is running on a black and white checkerboard. He jumps and the series logo appears from above. Pikachu passes by different Pokémon in a forest. Then, he is on top of followed by . After that, he briefly flies along with them. Pikachu passes by several more Pokémon and jumps on several buildings. Next, Pikachu walks near the sea. At the shore, Unova's three first partner Pokémon ( , , and ) are seen and Pikachu waves to each of them. He then passes by more Pokémon on a grassy field. Pikachu is floating in the air along with the other Pokémon. The opening ends with a group shot of Pikachu and the other Pokémon.

Where will we end up?
This uncomfortable feeling
Throw it all into that ocean

Has given me hope and energy
Listen to the sound from the bottom of one's heart
Still clear as before and still very familiar
